title: Enrichment class / private lesson exit
summary: Leaving Singapore with music, swim, ballet, or other private enrichment still mid-term — give notice, return borrowed gear, and float remaining term fees before packing week.

sections.title: Inventory every enrichment seat still live
sections.body: Private music, swim, ballet, coding, and sports coaching often renew on different calendars from school CCA. List every teacher, studio, and sibling seat still billed. Screenshot WhatsApp threads that hold verbal notice rules — studios rarely treat chat folklore as a written cancel.
bullets: List every active enrichment seat, including sibling add-ons
Screenshot studio notice rules and the latest fee schedule
Note borrowed instruments, costumes, or kit still at home

sections.title: Serve written notice inside the handbook window
sections.body: Many studios bill a full remaining term if notice arrives late. Email the studio address on the contract, keep the sent copy, and ask for a dated acknowledgement. Do not rely on a teacher saying “ok stop next week” in a parent chat.
bullets: Send written notice to the studio email on file, not only the teacher chat
Ask for a dated acknowledgement of the last paid class

sections.title: Return borrowed instruments, costumes, and kit
sections.body: Loan instruments and costume deposits often clear on a separate ledger from term fees. Photograph serial numbers before return and keep a signed receipt. Missing gear can wipe a deposit faster than an unpaid lesson week.
bullets: Return loaned instruments and costumes with a signed receipt
Keep kit-deposit cash separate from term-fee float

sections.title: Private enrichment vs tuition-centre bonds
sections.body: Centre-based tuition bonds and private one-to-one lessons are different contracts. Do not apply a tuition-centre bond calculator to a home piano teacher without checking the actual notice clause. Cross-link only when a child also sits in a bonded centre seat.
bullets: Treat private studio notice separately from centre bond clawbacks
Do not merge studio chat rules with centre handbook PDFs

sections.title: Stop GIRO / card rails after the last billed class
sections.body: Auto-debits often fire one more cycle after you think you cancelled. Confirm the last charge date in writing, then revoke GIRO or card mandates. Keep the SGD rail live until the final debit posts or the studio confirms a zero balance.
bullets: Confirm the last billed class date in writing before revoking GIRO
Revoke card mandates only after the final debit window closes
Hold a small float until the studio shows a zero balance

sections.title: Same-week stack with school and leaving playbooks
sections.body: Enrichment exits collide with school locker clear and packing week. Sequence written notices first, then gear returns, then fee float — so a late studio invoice does not raid the movers pot.
bullets: Put studio notice, gear return, and fee float on one calendar
Pair with /journeys/school-locker-clear when bags still hide costumes
Keep one adult free for studio callbacks during notice week
